vo.en: You must stop picking the middle option.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hand hovering indecisively over illuminated payment buttons on a modern vending machine.

vo.en: Quick test. A small coffee costs three dollars, and a large costs seven.

visual.description: Steam rising from freshly brewed black coffee being poured from an overhead kettle into a minimalist ceramic mug.

vo.en: Now add a medium for six-fifty. Suddenly, the seven-dollar cup feels like an obvious bargain.

visual.description: Fast-motion sliding of dollar bills across a polished dark counter next to commercial price tags.

vo.en: Wait until you realize the creepy secret behind this.

visual.description: Extreme macro close-up of a man's dilated pupil reflecting flashing digital data streams in darkness.

vo.en: MIT behavioral studies proved nobody actually wants the medium. It exists purely as an asymmetric decoy, driving you straight into the highest price.

visual.description: Overhead mechanical shot of a steel ball bearing rapidly navigating through a complex wooden maze.

vo.en: Streaming services, cinema popcorn, and tech upgrades use this exact trick to drain billions from your wallet every year.

visual.description: Rapid upward tilt of towering financial district glass skyscrapers illuminated against a dusk skyline.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if this worked on you, which is exactly why...

visual.description: Overhead view of a man's hand sliding a gleaming gold token decisively across a dark slate chessboard.
